description: A league's competition period is composed of its matches; a match record cannot exist without the league it belongs to.
A country's competition structure is composed of the leagues held in it; a league cannot exist without its country.

connection_condition: Match.home_team_api_id and Match.away_team_api_id each correspond to Team.team_api_id, so a match references its two teams through two separate identifier columns
description: Every match involves a home team and an away team; team participation is recorded per match rather than through a membership record, so the connection is an association between two concepts rather than a part-of composition.
A player's attribute history is composed of dated attribute snapshots; a snapshot row cannot exist without its player.
A team's tactical profile is composed of dated attribute snapshots; a snapshot row cannot exist without its team.
Player age is computed from the date of birth relative to a reference instant; a more recent date of birth yields a smaller age.
A drawn match is inferred from the goals of both teams: a match counts as a draw when the home team goal count equals the away team goal count.
The average player attribute value is derived from the attribute snapshot records of the qualifying players by dividing the summed attribute value by the number of those records.
The build up play speed class is the categorical band derived from the numeric build up play speed score of the same snapshot.
The chance creation passing class is the categorical band derived from the numeric chance creation passing score of the same snapshot.

connection_condition: Player.player_api_id and Player.player_fifa_api_id are both declared unique on the same Player row
description: The player API identifier and the player FIFA identifier label the same player one-to-one, while originating from different identifier systems.

connection_condition: Player_Attributes.id addresses one row of Player_Attributes
description: The surrogate row identifier addresses a single attribute snapshot row; it does not identify a player, since one player owns many snapshot rows.

Overall rating and strength are distinct player metrics on comparable numeric scales; the phrase 'overall strength' denotes the composite overall rating, whereas a bare 'strength' denotes the physical strength skill score.
